# qq-ai-bot

Copyright (c) 2026 chennianlaobai. MIT license: see LICENSE.

The unmodified persona.md and persona_rules.json are bundled from commit 5f998029bd90bacace68fa2c719722976470f44d of https://github.com/chennianlaobai/qq-ai-bot. SOURCE.json records their SHA256 hashes.

Cupbox adapts the Python chat/QA behavior to its existing JavaScript/OneBot runtime: named role metadata, original-user image permissions, scoped persistent memory, explicit real-identity honesty and fixed-capacity delivery remain enforced. No upstream example images or live credentials are included.
